projection_schema.canonical_json: UTF-8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False); exact integers; unique facts sorted by fact_key

excluded_outer_kind_meanings.session_meta: source metadata; producer claim independently reviewed, never inferred by runtime
excluded_outer_kind_meanings.response_item: private model/tool content; no quantities or corrections selected
excluded_outer_kind_meanings.world_state: model-visible context comparison baseline/patch; not usage authority
excluded_outer_kind_meanings.turn_context: configured context/model metadata; no served model join
excluded_outer_kind_meanings.inter_agent_communication_metadata: causal trigger metadata; not usage or correction authority
excluded_outer_kind_meanings.event_msg: task/item lifecycle and overlapping token_count snapshots; no additive authority

producer_claim.claim_scope: selected16requestrows only; no generic build compatibility

decisions.authority: Support covers only the finite admitted serialized request-observation subset: 16 requests and 96 category facts from the exact source SHA. Preserve six categories separately; no category sums, reconstructed total, backend presence certainty, complete account usage or other quantities.
decisions.interval: Request interval, served model/version, finality and total completeness remain unknown. No turn-context model join or timestamp-derived interval. Reported lineage is partial metadata only.
decisions.replay: Admit exact bytes before replay. Event key H([codex-request-event-v1,Codex,desktop-coding,original_thread,response]); fact key H([codex-request-fact-v1,event,request,category]). Canonical meaning includes quantity, basis, lineage, producer and fixed unknowns; excludes file/profile/approval/ordinal/availability. Equal facts reuse first Evidence/NativeUsage/provenance. Any conflict aborts the entire batch. Later admissions preserve event keys; incompatible mapping revisions require migration, never a new-key escape.
decisions.reset: No turn/thread/legacy differencing, epochs or baseline inference. Those representations yield no facts. Whole-file SHA admission excludes unreviewed resumes and new bytes. Selected direct rows must be adjudicated as responses, not inherited adjustments. Runtime claims no general reset detector.
decisions.correction: Corrections are unsupported. Review must establish that selected rows are independent response observations, not corrective replacements. Unadmitted bytes reject. Same-key changed meaning conflicts atomically. Distinct-ID corrections are excluded during independent admission; conflict logic alone cannot detect them. No invented revision, predecessor or reason.
decisions.exclusions: All other SHA/surface/version/producer subsets, Work/native-2, appends, resumes, forks, unreviewed rows, mixed-producer histories and oversized parents are unadmitted. Byte-identical copies/renames share admission. No complete Run/Change/all-attempt/descendant/finality, billed-money, demand-learning or automatic-binding authority; retain current financial and synthetic guards.
